purpose: Proposed missing activity phases for review; not quotations from Teacher's Book
source_basis: Existing verified Teacher's Book guidance in batch03

proposals.warm_up: Teacher shows three toy pictures from the unit scene. Pupils point to a toy they recognise and name it.
proposals.ending_lesson: Teacher points to the same toy pictures in a different order. Pupils name each toy without the recording.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher shows toy pictures from the previous lesson. Pupils recall and say the toy words before listening to the song.
proposals.ending_lesson: In pairs, pupils name their favourite toy using the song vocabulary; teacher invites two pairs to share.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher displays two toy pictures and models a short description. Pupils guess the correct toy.
proposals.ending_lesson: Teacher describes one toy without pointing. Pupils identify it and explain the picture clue.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher shows the first go-kart story picture. Pupils predict what might happen using words or gestures.
Teacher displays two pictures from the go-kart story. Pupils recall which event happened first.
proposals.ending_lesson: Pairs choose one story picture and say a short phrase from the episode; teacher checks meaning.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher shows two contrasting toy pictures. Pupils name visible features before reading.
proposals.ending_lesson: Teacher reads one description aloud. Pupils identify the matching go-kart and cite a clue.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher displays a toy picture and states one true and one false description. Pupils signal true or false.
proposals.ending_lesson: Pairs correct one false statement orally, then share their correction with the class.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher shows toy pictures and asks pupils to name a favourite toy using a short model sentence.
proposals.ending_lesson: Pupils show their drawing to a partner and say one descriptive sentence; teacher checks written labels.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher holds up or draws a triangle and a square. Pupils name the shapes and find them in a tangram picture.
proposals.ending_lesson: Pairs point to shapes in their tangram pictures and name at least two shapes.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher shows a completed tangram picture and asks pupils to identify its component shapes.
proposals.ending_lesson: Pupils display their tangram and describe one shape and the completed picture to a partner.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher models a simple picture description without showing the picture. Pupils imagine what it could look like.
proposals.ending_lesson: Pupils exchange pictures and describe one detail they can see in their partner's drawing.

proposals.warm_up: Teacher shows familiar toy and shape pictures. Pupils recall words from the unit.
